svg.aria-label: The rule language in three layers. Layer one: a registry of variable and event declarations, each carrying a version-pinned terminology binding, a role, a plausible range, and an unbound flag marking a named hole. Layer two: a grammar of four leaf nodes — comparison, interval, recency, relative change — plus not, and, or; a worked example is drawn as an expression tree whose leaves are tagged with the logical fragment each requires, and the rule's fragment is the maximum over the tree. Layer three: the rule is an implication under a deontic operator, with action and target carrying no semantics, and refusal available as an alternative outcome of the same decode.

text.style: font-family:JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace; font-weight:700; font-size:11px; fill:#0B5F55; letter-spacing:.12em
